content.short: API for moving money between bank rails, cards, wallets and stablecoins, with compliance built in.
content.description: HIFI handles deposits from banks, cards and wallets, lets a business set rules on what money can do once inside, and routes payouts to any destination, including push-to-card through Visa Direct. It also issues and redeems tokenized cash and real-world assets. Customers range from young fintechs to Fortune 100 companies, and it recently raised a $37 million Series A.
content.meta: HIFI's single API moves money across banks, cards and stablecoins, with controls, tokenization and Visa Direct payouts.
